subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired and final exact-head validation passes, should the verified grouped action revisions be approved for the token-, release-, security-, publishing-, and agent-bearing workflows?
rationale: The source repair is mechanical, but accepting new third-party executable revisions across CODEOWNERS-protected automation boundaries requires human security intent.

options.title: Approve after synchronized repair
options.body: Fix all four assertions, rerun focused and exact-head validation, and approve the verified immutable revisions as one group.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, publishing, security-scanning, and Codex action revisions into smaller independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Retain current revisions until protected-path owners are ready to review the complete execution boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve after synchronized repair
recommendation.body: Fix all four assertions, rerun focused and exact-head validation, and approve the verified immutable revisions as one group.
